_comment: Regression gate, not a quality claim. hap.py limits sit just below the lower
bound of the 95% interval measured on the reference run (docs/RESULTS.md): a run
fails only when it is worse than statistical noise allows. Read-level limits
follow expectations for a PCR-free NovaSeq library; optical duplicates are a
flow-cell property and are not gated, library (PCR) duplicates are.
Recalibrate with docs/METHODOLOGY.md#qc-gate when the caller or the data change.
